subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do maintainers approve these updated third-party action revisions for workflows that pass GitHub App private keys, Docker registry credentials, or OpenAI API keys after reviewing their release/source changes?
rationale: The code changes are mechanical pin updates, but accepting new executable action revisions inside credentialed workflows is a repository trust-boundary decision that cannot be resolved from Dependabot metadata or ordinary CI alone.

options.title: Audit and approve the revisions
options.body: Review the upstream revision diffs and credential-handling contracts, then allow the rebased exact head to merge after required checks pass.

options.title: Hold the sensitive updates
options.body: Keep the current pinned revisions for credentialed workflows and split or close this broad Dependabot update until the action audit is complete.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the revisions
recommendation.body: Review the upstream revision diffs and credential-handling contracts, then allow the rebased exact head to merge after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They subscribed to the PR during the active review window; this is a low-confidence routing signal rather than a claim of code ownership.
